scope: exact restore and external archive ownership review
properties: every immediate restore or archive item requires an explicit disposition
decisions are bound to exact preflight, root, path, device, inode and kind
new, replaced, forged, incomplete and unknown items fail closed
reviewed erasure is restricted to direct children of explicit review roots
unrelated siblings survive and reviewed symlinks are never followed
limitations: The live installation items still require their own ownership decisions.
This review primitive does not infer ownership or execute the reset.
Preservation orchestration, volume erasure, initialization and fresh live acceptance remain pending.
